param.query:
SELECT a.*, b.n_years_excess, b.consec_excess
FROM #{DF(0)} a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT school_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN excess_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_years_excess,
    CASE WHEN
      (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 AND excess_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
       AND MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 AND excess_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)
      OR
      (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 AND excess_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
       AND MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 AND excess_rate > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS consec_excess
  FROM #{DF(0)}
  GROUP BY school_code
) b ON a.school_code = b.school_code

SELECT  q.*,
  CASE WHEN q.risk_high = 1 AND q.consec_excess = 1 THEN '학교고유형'
       WHEN q.risk_high = 1 THEN '구조형' ELSE '-' END AS risk_origin,
  CASE
    WHEN q.quadrant = '1_고위험저이용' AND q.aux_staff_type = '4_none' AND COALESCE(q.aux_counsel_ex_n,0) = 0 THEN 'P1 순회교사 신규배치'
    WHEN q.quadrant = '1_고위험저이용' AND q.aux_staff_type = '4_none' THEN 'P2 상주 상담인력 배치 검토'
    WHEN q.quadrant = '1_고위험저이용' AND q.aux_staff_type IN ('2_temp_est','3_other_est') THEN 'P2 정규 상담교사 배치 검토'
    WHEN q.quadrant = '1_고위험저이용' THEN 'P3 운영점검·외부연계'
    WHEN q.quadrant = '2_고위험고이용' THEN '추가인력·외부연계 검토'
    WHEN q.quadrant = '3_저위험저이용' THEN '모니터링'
    ELSE '현 수준 유지'
  END AS prescription
FROM (
  SELECT s.*, e.n_years_excess, e.consec_excess,
    CASE WHEN s.risk_pct >= 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS risk_high,
    CASE
      WHEN s.risk_pct >= 0.75 AND s.use_pct <= 50 THEN '1_고위험저이용'
      WHEN s.risk_pct >= 0.75 THEN '2_고위험고이용'
      WHEN s.use_pct <= 50 THEN '3_저위험저이용'
      ELSE '4_저위험고이용'
    END AS quadrant
  FROM (
    SELECT b.*,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #{DF(1)} r2 WHERE r2.risk_score_2026 < b.risk_score_2026) * 1.0
        / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #{DF(1)}) - 1) AS risk_pct,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #{DF(0)} p2 WHERE p2.is_seoul = 1 AND p2.aux_counsel_in_per100 < b.aux_counsel_in_per100) * 100.0
        / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #{DF(0)} p3 WHERE p3.is_seoul = 1) - 1) AS use_pct
    FROM (
      SELECT p.*, r.risk_score_2026
      FROM #{DF(0)} p JOIN #{DF(1)} r ON p.school_code = r.school_code
      WHERE p.is_seoul = 1
    ) b
  ) s
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT school_code, MAX(n_years_excess) AS n_years_excess, MAX(consec_excess) AS consec_excess
    FROM #{DF(2)} GROUP BY school_code
  ) e ON s.school_code = e.school_code
) q

import pandas as pd

inputDataframe = inputs[0].copy()

# 1. 일반고와 자율고를 하나의 유형으로 통합
inputDataframe["_school_type_group"] = (
    inputDataframe["school_type"].replace({"자율고": "일반고"})
)

# 2. 같은 연도·학교 유형의 평균 중단율 계산
inputDataframe["_type_year_mean_rate"] = (
    inputDataframe.groupby(
        ["target_year", "_school_type_group"]
    )["target_dropout_rate"].transform("mean")
)

# 3. 학교 유형 평균 대비 초과 중단율 계산
inputDataframe["_excess_rate"] = (
    inputDataframe["target_dropout_rate"]
    - inputDataframe["_type_year_mean_rate"]
)

# 4. 같은 연도·학교 유형 내 초과 중단율의 상위 25% 기준 계산
inputDataframe["_type_q75"] = (
    inputDataframe.groupby(
        ["target_year", "_school_type_group"]
    )["_excess_rate"].transform(lambda s: s.quantile(0.75))
)

# 5. 기존 label OR 유형별 초과 중단율 상위 25%
inputDataframe["label_high_risk"] = (
    (inputDataframe["label"] == 1)
    | (inputDataframe["_excess_rate"] >= inputDataframe["_type_q75"])
).astype(int)

# 6. 임시 계산 열 제거
inputDataframe = inputDataframe.drop(
    columns=[
        "_school_type_group",
        "_type_year_mean_rate",
        "_excess_rate",
        "_type_q75"
    ]
)

result = inputDataframe

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = inputs[0].copy()

# 0. 다음 해 중단율 열 찾기 (패널에 없는 열 1개 = [A] 다음 해 중단율 붙이기 결과)
panel_cols = ['school_code','school_name','sido_code','sido','sigungu','is_seoul','school_type','found_type','coed','day_night',
 'lat','lon','found_date','year','students','log_students','dropout_n','dropout_rate','g1_dropout_n','g1_dropout_rate',
 'g2_dropout_n','g2_dropout_rate','g3_dropout_n','g3_dropout_rate','g1_dropout_share','transfer_in_n','transfer_out_n',
 'transfer_in_rate','transfer_out_rate','g1_transfer_out_rate','n_classes','students_per_class','n_teachers',
 'students_per_teacher','teachers_total','temp_teachers','temp_teacher_ratio','counsel_in_n','counsel_in_yn','counsel_ex_n',
 'counsel_ex_yn','counsel_in_per100','counsel_ex_per100','wee_class','counselor_regular','counselor_regular_leave',
 'counselor_cert','counselor_temp_est','staff_type','valid_row','flag_teacher_imputed','flag_small_school',
 'flag_counsel_missing','flag_counsel_zero','flag_counsel_outlier','flag_new_school','flag_size_jump','flag_disclosure_excluded']
lead_col = [c for c in df.columns if c not in panel_cols][0]

# 1. 학습 쌍 식별 열 만들기
df['feature_year'] = df['year'].astype(int)
df['target_year'] = df['feature_year'] + 1
df['pair_id'] = df['feature_year'].astype(str) + 'to' + df['target_year'].astype(str)
df['target_dropout_rate'] = df[lead_col]
df['sido_code'] = df['sido_code'].astype(int)

# 2. 2023 교원·학급 값은 2024 값으로 대체된 것이라 비움 (미래 정보 차단)
teacher_cols = ['n_classes','students_per_class','n_teachers','students_per_teacher','temp_teacher_ratio']
df.loc[df['feature_year'] == 2023, teacher_cols] = np.nan

# 3. 상담 관련 열은 보조 지표로 표시 (예측 변수와 구분)
aux = ['counsel_in_n','counsel_in_per100','counsel_ex_n','counsel_ex_per100','counsel_in_yn','wee_class',
       'counselor_regular','counselor_cert','counselor_temp_est','staff_type']
df = df.rename(columns={c: 'aux_' + c for c in aux})

# 4. 파이썬 학습 쌍과 같은 열 순서·행 순서로 정리
cols = (['pair_id','feature_year','target_year',
         'school_code','school_name','sido_code','sido','sigungu','is_seoul','lat','lon',
         'school_type','found_type','coed','day_night',
         'students','log_students','dropout_n','dropout_rate','g1_dropout_n','g1_dropout_rate','g2_dropout_rate','g3_dropout_rate',
         'g1_dropout_share','transfer_in_rate','transfer_out_rate','g1_transfer_out_rate']
        + teacher_cols + ['aux_' + c for c in aux]
        + ['flag_teacher_imputed','flag_small_school','flag_counsel_missing','flag_counsel_zero','flag_counsel_outlier',
           'flag_new_school','flag_size_jump','flag_disclosure_excluded','target_dropout_rate'])
df = df[cols].sort_values(['feature_year','school_code']).reset_index(drop=True)

result = df
